name: Keepa
description: Amazon product intelligence for price and sales-rank history, estimated monthly sales, bestseller lists, product discovery, deals, offers, categories, and seller research. Requires a paid Keepa API subscription; usage is token-metered.

credential_fields.name: api_key
credential_fields.label: API access key
credential_fields.description: Keepa API access key from keepa.com/#!api. A paid API subscription is required; the key is injected automatically and never needs to be passed to a tool.

tools.name: get_products
tools.description: Get up to 100 Amazon products by comma-separated ASINs or product codes, including price and sales-rank history by default. Optional stats provide current/min/max/average values; offers, Buy Box, stock, ratings, and refreshes cost extra tokens. monthlySold values are Keepa estimates, not verified copies sold.

domain.description: Amazon locale: 1 US, 2 UK, 3 DE, 4 FR, 5 JP, 6 CA, 8 IT, 9 ES, 10 IN, 11 MX, 12 BR.

asin.description: One ASIN or a comma-separated batch of up to 100 ASINs. Use either asin or code.

code.description: One UPC, EAN, or ISBN-13, or a comma-separated batch of up to 100. Use either code or asin.

stats.description: Statistics interval: recent day count such as 90, or two ISO dates/timestamps separated by a comma.

update.description: Refresh if older than this many hours. 0 forces live refresh and may cost more; -1 never refreshes.

history.description: Set 0 to omit price and sales-rank history and reduce response size.

days.description: Limit all historical series to the most recent number of days.

code_limit.description: Maximum products returned per UPC/EAN/ISBN code.

offers.description: Fetch 20–100 current marketplace offers. This substantially increases token cost and latency.

only_live_offers.description: With offers, set 1 to omit historical offers.

rating.description: Include existing rating and review-count history; can cost one extra token per product.

buybox.description: Include Buy Box history; costs two extra tokens per product and is redundant when offers is used.

stock.description: With offers, include stock history where available; can cost two extra tokens per product.

historical_variations.description: Include historical/out-of-stock variations; costs extra tokens.

tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Search Amazon products by keyword in marketplace order, excluding sponsored results. Returns product objects with history, or an ASIN-only list for a smaller response.

asins_only.description: Set 1 to return only ordered ASINs.

stats.description: Statistics interval such as 90 days or an ISO date range.

update.description: Refresh products older than this many hours; 0 can cost extra.

rating.description: Include available rating/review history; can cost extra.

tools.name: find_products
tools.description: Run Keepa Product Finder filters against its Amazon database and return ASINs, with optional aggregate search insights. Useful for stable-rank, low-competition, price, review, category, brand, and estimated-monthly-sales research. At least one selection filter is required.

stats.description: Set 1 for aggregate Search Insights; adds token cost.

selection.description: Keepa Product Finder query. Common fields include title, rootCategory, categories_include/exclude, brand, manufacturer, current_SALES_gte/lte, avg30_SALES_gte/lte, monthlySold_gte/lte, current_AMAZON_gte/lte, current_BUY_BOX_SHIPPING_gte/lte, hasReviews, page, perPage, and sort such as [["avg90_SALES","asc"]]. Additional documented filters are accepted.

monthlySold_gte.description: Minimum Keepa-estimated monthly units sold; not verified Amazon sales.

monthlySold_lte.description: Maximum Keepa-estimated monthly units sold; not verified Amazon sales.

current_AMAZON_gte.description: Minimum Amazon price in the marketplace's smallest currency unit.

tools.name: list_best_sellers
tools.description: Return an ordered ASIN list for a category or product group using current rank, a 30/90/180-day average, or a historical month. Lists are generally updated hourly.

category.description: Amazon category node ID or product group such as Beauty.

range.description: Rank averaging period; do not combine with month/year or sublist=1.

month.description: Historical month; supply year too and omit range.

variations.description: Set 1 to return all variations instead of one representative per parent.

sublist.description: Use subcategory/classification rank; do not combine with range/month/year.

tools.name: browse_deals
tools.description: Browse products with recent price/rank changes. Keepa deal data covers products updated within roughly 12 hours and returns up to 150 results per page.

selection.description: Deal query. domainId and exactly one priceTypes value are required; common filters include deltaPercentRange, salesRankRange, currentRange, includeCategories, minRating, titleSearch, dateRange, page, and sortType.

tools.name: lookup_categories
tools.description: Look up up to 10 comma-separated Amazon category node IDs, optionally including their parent trees. Use category=0 to list root categories.

category.description: One category ID, 0 for roots, or up to 10 comma-separated IDs.

tools.name: search_categories
tools.description: Search Amazon category names and return up to 50 category objects and node IDs.

term.description: All space-separated words must match; each word must be at least three characters.

tools.name: get_sellers
tools.description: Get Amazon seller identity, business details, rating history, FBA status, catalogue statistics, competitors, and optional storefront ASINs. Supports up to 100 comma-separated seller IDs unless storefront=1.

seller.description: One seller ID or up to 100 comma-separated seller IDs.

storefront.description: Set 1 for storefront ASINs; costs nine extra tokens and only permits one seller.

tools.name: find_sellers
tools.description: Find Amazon seller IDs by name, business details, country, ratings, FBA activity, storefront size, Buy Box performance, or catalogue profile. At least one selection filter is required.

selection.description: Keepa Seller Finder query. Common fields include search, addressCountry, currentRating_gte/lte, currentRatingCount_gte/lte, hasFBA, totalStorefrontAsins_gte/lte, activeOnly, page, perPage, and sort. Additional documented filters are accepted.

tools.name: list_top_sellers
tools.description: Return up to 100,000 seller IDs ordered by Amazon marketplace rating count. Lists are updated daily and cost 50 Keepa tokens.
